hypotheses.L1_selected_subspace_field_recurs: Every nonreference seed has mean same-context selected-subspace cosine at least 0.80 on every corpus.
hypotheses.L2_selected_field_beats_context_shuffle: Every observed same-context overlap exceeds the 95th percentile of 32 shuffled-context nulls.
hypotheses.L3_hard_score_function_recurs: Every nonreference hard program has centered score R-squared at least 0.80 against the reference on every corpus.
hypotheses.L4_output_function_recurs: Every nonreference program has mean exact output KL at most 0.002 from the reference approximation on every corpus.
hypotheses.L5_disagreement_sites_still_share_subspa: On sites whose globally aligned route labels disagree, selected-subspace cosine remains at least 0.75 for every seed and corpus.
hypotheses.L6_field_is_more_canonical_than_labels: Selected-subspace recurrence passes while the prior 60% OOD route-label agreement gate failed.
